title: The Prong Poker of Politically Correct Pyrotechnics
description: The Prong Poker of Politically Correct Pyrotechnics — The Townstons wiki
html:
The Prong Poker of Politically Correct Pyrotechnics
Piece:  Weapon
Class:  Mage
Damage:  varies with item level

The Prong Poker of Politically Correct Pyrotechnics is a mage rainbow weapon.

Attributes:

The name and the look are fixed. Primaries roll as a Endurance / Intellect mix. That roll is the joke ending on Mythic Suffixes.

The rest of the stats roll and do not show up in the name.

  • Resists: a pair or triple that is not fire.
  • Health / mana: health, mana, or both. Random.

It is unknown how many different varieties exist. The same ending can still drop with different rolls underneath.
